11-coordinates.title: Python: coordinates in a different basis

nodes.text: The basis and the target vector

states.caption: The columns of V form the skew basis. v is the fixed target (3, 2).
solve(V, v) finds c = (1, 2). The weighted basis arrows reach v.
V @ c reconstructs v, and rank(V) = 2 confirms two independent directions.
M has rank 2. Its columns span a plane in output space.
null_space(M) finds one basis vector: N(M) is a line in input space.
M @ N is zero, and rank + nullity = 2 + 1 = 3 input coordinates.
